title: The injective degree of the two-open section complex is short exact
statement: Let X be a scheme, U,V opens with U union V = X, I a nonnegative cochain complex of abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and q a natural number. If I^q is injective [def-sp-injective-resolutions], then evaluation in degree q of etaleSectionShortComplex(U,V,I) [def-weil-pbc-etale-mayer-vietoris-section-complex] is short exact [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence]. No condition is imposed on other degrees or on the augmentation of I.

source.place: Tag 0A50, proof, short exact complexes of sections; agent-written pullback and Ext comparison in steps 1, 2 and 4 of lem-weil-pbc-etale-mayer-vietoris-connecting-pullback. Read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0A50 (literature checkout absent locally).

proof.text: Define the square of the etale objects U intersection V, U, V, and X. Scheme.isPullback_opens_inf identifies the intersection pullback after forgetting to schemes; reflect that pullback to the etale category. Scheme.ofArrows_mem_smallEtaleTopology_iff and the open-cover hypothesis show the two arrows generate a covering sieve.

Forget an abelian sheaf to sets, preserving its sheaf condition. Construct a pullback cone using amalgamateOfArrows on the two-open covering. For mixed pairs use the intersection pullback to verify compatibility; for equal pairs use monicity of the inclusion. The restriction and uniqueness equations of amalgamation verify the cone universal property. Reflect the resulting pullback of sets to abelian groups. Square.IsPullback.isLimitKernelFork and exact_and_mono_f_iff_f_is_kernel give middle exactness and monicity of the pair.

For any monomorphism f:A to B of etale objects, the map from the free abelian sheaf of uliftYoneda(A) to that of uliftYoneda(B) is mono, by preservation of monos by lifted Yoneda, the free abelian group functor and sheafification. The sheafification adjunction, whiskered free-forgetful adjunction and uliftYonedaEquiv give an equivalence between maps from this free sheaf to I^q and sections on A. Their three naturality identities identify precomposition with restriction. Injective.factorThru extends the map for any section on A across this mono; Injective.comp_factorThru proves the resulting section on B restricts to it. Apply this to U intersection V to U. A section on U with zero second component then proves surjectivity of the difference.

Functor.mapBiprod for evaluation gives an isomorphism between the degree q evaluation of the explicit section short complex and this section-group short complex. biprod.map_lift_mapBiprod identifies the first arrow; map_neg and biprod.mapBiprod_hom_desc identify the second. Transport short exactness using ShortComplex.shortExact_iff_of_iso. All steps have been implemented in Lean with no sorry.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0A50, proof, first route via injective restriction surjectivity; complete Lean implementation using free lifted Yoneda sheaves, injective extension, and sheaf amalgamation.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleSectionShortComplex_degreewise_shortExact
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (U V : X.Opens) (hcover : U ⊔ V = ⊤)
    (I : CochainComplex (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ℕ)
    (q : ℕ) [Injective (I.X q)] :
    ((etaleSectionShortComplex U V I).map
      (HomologicalComplex.eval AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (.up ℕ) q)).ShortExact
